source.title: Guidelines for Competency Based Postgraduate Training Programme for MD in General Medicine (revised)

requirements.label: Research Methodology course — within six months of the batch commencing
requirements.quote: All postgraduate students shall complete an online course in Research Methodology within six months of the commencement of the batch and generate the online certificate on successful completion of the course.
requirements.note: STRICTER than PGMER-2023 5.2(xi)(a), which says 'first year'. Both are shown; the module never silently replaces the regulation's deadline with the curriculum's.

requirements.label: Departmental lectures attended
requirements.quote: Didactic lectures should be used sparingly. A minimum of 10 lectures per year in the concerned PG department is suggested. … All postgraduate trainees will be required to attend these lectures.

requirements.label: Journal club
requirements.quote: Journal club: Minimum of once in 1-2 weeks is suggested. Topics will include presentation and critical appraisal of original research papers published in peer reviewed indexed journals. The presenter(s) shall be assessed by faculty and grades recorded in the logbook.
requirements.note: 'once in 1-2 weeks' is a RANGE. The pack uses the conservative end (once a fortnight) so the module never reports a resident behind on a cadence the curriculum does not actually demand.

requirements.label: Student seminar
requirements.quote: Student Seminar: Minimum of once every 1-2 weeks is suggested. … The student should be graded by the faculty and peers.

requirements.label: Student symposium
requirements.quote: Student Symposium: Minimum of once every 3 months. … All participating postgraduates should be graded by the faculty and peers.

requirements.label: Laboratory work / bedside clinics
requirements.clause: Teaching-Learning methods — E. Laboratory work / Bedside clinics
requirements.quote: Laboratory work / Bedside clinics: Minimum - once every 1-2 weeks. … Various methods like DOAP (Demonstrate, Observe, Assist, Perform), simulations in skills lab, and case-based discussions etc. are to be used.

requirements.label: Interdepartmental colloquium
requirements.quote: Faculty and students must attend monthly meetings between the main Department and other department/s on topics of current/common interest or clinical cases.

requirements.label: Case presentation / work-up / handling
requirements.quote: Quarterly assessment during the MD training should be based on: Case presentation, case work up, case handling/management : once a week

requirements.label: Laboratory performance
requirements.note: The curriculum writes the number as a word: 'twice a week' — target 2 per week.

requirements.label: Case discussions
requirements.note: The curriculum gives 'fortnight/month'. The pack uses the conservative end (monthly).

requirements.label: Attendance at scientific meetings / CME programmes
requirements.quote: Attendance at Scientific meetings, CME programmes (at least 02 each)

requirements.label: At least two presentations at a national-level conference
requirements.quote: At least two presentations at national level conference. One research paper should be published / accepted in an indexed journal. (It is suggested that the local or University Review committee assess the work sent for publication).
requirements.note: EXCEEDS PGMER-2023 5.2(x), which requires one poster OR one paper read OR one first-author publication. Both are evaluated and reported separately.

requirements.label: One research paper published / accepted in an indexed journal
requirements.quote: At least two presentations at national level conference. One research paper should be published / accepted in an indexed journal. (It is suggested that the local or University Review committee assess the work sent for publication).

requirements.label: Log book of work done submitted, incl. rotation postings, departmental presentations and internal assessment reports
requirements.quote: Log book of work done during the training period including rotation postings, departmental presentations, and internal assessment reports should be submitted.

requirements.label: District Residency Programme posting
requirements.clause: Teaching-Learning methods — G.(b) Posting under District Residency Programme
requirements.quote: All postgraduate students pursuing MS/MS in broad specialties in all Medical Colleges/Institutions shall undergo a compulsory rotation of three months in District Hospitals/District Health System as a part of the course curriculum … Such rotation shall take place in the 3rd or 4th or 5th semester.

proceduresNote: The MD General Medicine guidelines prescribe no procedure counts. Procedure entries are counted; the department sets targets in-app (which then display as institutional policy, not as NMC).
disclaimer: Requirements are traced to the NMC source named above. A requirement with target null is one the source mandates WITHOUT giving a number — it is counted, never scored against an invented target. This pack does not certify compliance; see NMC_PG_LOGBOOK_REQUIREMENTS.md.
